---
title: "Cyber Macro Impact Pilot"
format: html
---

## Research question

How are country-level cyber readiness and incident intensity associated with macro outcomes such as GDP growth, productivity, investment, and employment?

## Data

This report uses the processed panel at `data_processed/panel_country_year.parquet`.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
	library(arrow)
	library(dplyr)
	library(knitr)
})

panel_path <- "data_processed/panel_country_year.parquet"
dict_path <- "data_processed/data_dictionary.csv"

if (!file.exists(panel_path)) {
	stop("Missing panel file. Run R/03_build_panel.R first.")
}

panel <- arrow::read_parquet(panel_path)

summary_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
	metric = c("Rows", "Countries", "Year min", "Year max"),
	value = c(
		nrow(panel),
		dplyr::n_distinct(panel$iso3c),
		min(panel$year, na.rm = TRUE),
		max(panel$year, na.rm = TRUE)
	)
)

knitr::kable(summary_tbl, caption = "Panel snapshot")
```

```{r}
if (file.exists(dict_path)) {
	dict <- read.csv(dict_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
	knitr::kable(dict, caption = "Data dictionary")
}
```

## Baseline model

We use country and year fixed-effects models with lagged cyber variables and clustered standard errors at country level.

```{r}
headline_csv <- "output/tables/headline_regressions.csv"
robust_csv <- "output/tables/robustness_regressions.csv"

if (file.exists(headline_csv)) {
	headline <- read.csv(headline_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
	knitr::kable(headline, caption = "Headline FE models")
} else {
	cat("Headline table not found. Run R/04_model_specs.R.\n")
}
```

```{r}
if (file.exists(robust_csv)) {
	robust <- read.csv(robust_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
	knitr::kable(robust, caption = "Robustness FE models")
} else {
	cat("Robustness table not found. Run R/04_model_specs.R.\n")
}
```
